exposure: Third-trimester coagulation activity levels (<50 IU/dL vs >=50 IU/dL)
cohort: The study included 348 deliveries from women with von Willebrand disease or hemophilia carriers who delivered between 2012 and 2017 in the Netherlands.
finding: The incidence of severe primary PPH in women with VWD and HCs was 10% and remained stable over time, becoming comparable to the increasing prevalence in the general Dutch population.
